title: Proper derived pushforward preserves the adic bounded-constructible localizing hull
statement: Fix a universe u, a prime $\ell$, and a field $k$ in universe u of positive characteristic different from $\ell$. Let $Z,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and let $g:Z\to Y$ be a proper $k$-morphism [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring with its specified multiplication and a certificate of one of the three adic coefficient families [def-sfb-adic-coefficient-certificate]. For $T=Z,Y$, put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$, let $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T})$ be the ordinary unbounded module-object derived category [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], let $\mathcal B_T$ be its bounded constructible full subcategory [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], and let $\mathcal L_T=\operatorname{Loc}(\mathcal B_T)$ be the full localizing hull, using ambient coproducts indexed in universe u+1 [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-localizing-closure]. The ambient derived pushforward $Rg_*:D_Z\to D_Y$ sends every object of $\mathcal L_Z$ to an object of $\mathcal L_Y$.

source.note:
Construction material for the worker who claims this unsplit node. This is retained argument, not a completed proof. The original parent proof and the previous NH worker's expanded construction are preserved verbatim below.

Original parent step 1 (verbatim):
Prove the general closure criterion used in Lean. If an exact ambient functor F preserves coproducts after restriction to the source hull and maps bounded source objects to bounded target objects, put P equal to the intersection of the source hull and the inverse image of the target hull. P is replete and triangulated. Lift each P-valued discrete diagram and its ambient colimit cocone to the source hull. Full faithfulness reflects its colimit property, the coproduct hypothesis maps it to a colimit, and closure of the target hull puts that image colimit in the target hull. Thus P is closed under ambient sums. Minimality of the source hull proves the claim.
Cited nodes: [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-localizing-closure].

Original parent step 2 (verbatim):
Apply the closure criterion to actual Rg_*. It is triangulated as a total right derived functor. Case elimination of the indexed adic coefficient certificate supplies the existing IsFinitenessCoefficient instance in each of its three constructors. Proper bounded-constructible preservation is the proper adic specialization of boundedConstructible_rightDerivedLowerStar_obj; the coproduct input is the preceding localizing coproduct theorem.
Cited nodes: [lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated], [lem-sfb-dc-lower-star-preserves], [lem-sfb-adic-proper-localizing-coproducts], [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-localizing-closure].

Previous NH construction paragraph 1 (verbatim):
For an ambient triangulated functor $F:D_Z\to D_Y$ assume that $F i_Z$ preserves the specified coproducts and $F(\mathcal B_Z)\subseteq\mathcal B_Y$. Put $P=\mathcal L_Z\cap F^{-1}(\mathcal L_Y)$. Isomorphisms, shifts and distinguished triangles stay in $P$ by these properties of both hulls and by triangulatedness of $F$. Given a $P$-valued discrete diagram, its ambient coproduct lies in $\mathcal L_Z$; the cocone is also universal in the full source hull, since its mediating maps and uniqueness are the ambient ones. By preservation for $F i_Z$, its image is a coproduct in $D_Y$. All its summands lie in $\mathcal L_Y$, so closure of that hull gives $P$ for this coproduct. Finally $P$ contains $\mathcal B_Z$. Minimality in the definition of $\mathcal L_Z$ gives $\mathcal L_Z\subseteq P$, hence the containment.
Cited nodes: [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-localizing-closure].

Previous NH construction paragraph 2 (verbatim):
For the actual $Rg_*$, the right-derived-functor theorem supplies commutation with shifts and triangulatedness. Eliminating the three constructors of the adic coefficient certificate supplies the required finiteness-coefficient instance. The bounded-constructible image statement is [lem-sfb-dc-lower-star-preserves], and the source-hull coproduct hypothesis is [lem-sfb-adic-proper-localizing-coproducts]. Applying the closure argument of the preceding step yields $Rg_*(\mathcal L_Z)\subseteq\mathcal L_Y$.
Cited nodes: [lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated], [lem-sfb-dc-lower-star-preserves], [lem-sfb-adic-proper-localizing-coproducts], [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-localizing-closure], [def-sfb-adic-coefficient-certificate].
